sources.snippet: Qwen 3.5 is the most capable open-weight small model family available right now. The small series (0.8B, 2B, 4B, 9B) was designed from the ground up for on-device deployment. It uses a hybrid architecture combining Gated Delta Networks with sparse Mixture-of-Experts, supports 200+ languages, and handles a 262K context window. You can run it locally on your iPhone.
